label: step-3 token-combination detector (strongest at <DEL> of L=3 after n/z then h/u)
explanation: Fires almost only at absolute step t=3 (98% of activations, 99% of mass). It never fires at t<=1 or t>=5, and never in the copy phase after the delimiter. Within t=3 it is sparse (about 3% of t=3 steps) and depends on the specific tokens. The largest activations are the <DEL> step of L=3 sequences (44% of mass, 6% rate), especially when orig(1) is n/z and orig(2) is h/u (e.g. w n h <DEL>). For longer sequences it fires on the 4th original token, mostly when that token is 2, y or r. Preceding tokens h/u/z/b/i/r/g/n raise the rate, as does a token two back of n/z/u/f. Activations are nearly always on the first occurrence of the input token. Requiring t=3 plus the input-token and previous-token sets gives F1 about 0.4 on dev. The exact token lookup is only partly captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 (+7.46), prev_tok=h (+2.94), prev2_tok=n (+2.81), phase=0 & in_tok=2 (+2.79), phase=0 & in_tok=y (+2.69), orig0=n (+2.67). Lower it: orig2=q (-3.90), prev_tok=t (-3.85), orig2=c (-3.85), orig2=0 (-3.85).
